note: Real briefs, not smoke tests: each is a product somebody would actually bring to 「循证 GEO」, chosen for the specific way steps 1–3 go wrong while looking finished — the wrong holder's label, a claim stronger than its source, a composed question filed as a patient's words. mustDo / mustNotDo are the rubric; the deterministic half (quote in its preserved source, a real phrasing with its URL, the files at their names) is the geo-insight-pack contract in @evimed/domain.

briefs.title: 信尔美（玛仕度肽注射液）：完整的证据、旅程与问题
briefs.why: A new first-in-class weight-management injection with a dense social conversation about 减肥针. The ordinary full case, and the one where every downstream number depends on the claim library: an indication written wider than the label here becomes an AI answer judged 'correct' later.
mustDo: Lock identity from the current China label: holder, form, strengths, prescription status, the approved indication and its population thresholds word for word.
Quote every claim verbatim from a preserved source and cite the .evimed-sources path it is in; the label's contraindications, warnings and special populations are claims too.
Run a patient line and a physician line, because it is a prescription medicine.
Hang every red flag the label names on a care node, and say which node needs a 就医 prompt.
Collect real phrasings through the social channel; where a platform returns nothing, write 无信号 for it.
Measure 40–120 questions across all four pools with 3–5 control groups of the same pool and difficulty, and put off-label and special-population questions in P4.
Record every default taken (coverage, engines, focus SKU) in assumptions[] with its reason and how to change it.
mustNotDo: Write a claim that the medicine suits people outside the label's population (for example cosmetic weight loss at a normal BMI).
Carry a comparative efficacy claim against 司美格鲁肽 or 替尔泊肽 that no head-to-head source states.
File a question the run wrote itself as kind real.
Ask the user anything other than which product, if identity cannot be fixed.
Probe the engines in batch inside the run.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether the claim library and the locked question set would let a pharmacist judge an AI answer correct or wrong without going back to the label.

briefs.title: 连花清瘟胶囊：只列问题（最小测量集）
briefs.why: A single step with no upstream, for a traditional Chinese medicine whose label speaks in 功能主治 rather than indications. The minimal path has to say it is minimal, and a TCM label split into parallel 'indications' is the failure a reader cannot see.

brandEntity.name: 连花清瘟胶囊
brandEntity.holder: 石家庄以岭药业股份有限公司

mustDo: Build only the minimal upstream the step needs: identity and label claims, then a set of 30 measured questions across the four pools.
Keep the label's 功能, 主治 and symptom layers as the label writes them, not as parallel indications.
Check the prescription or OTC status from the label record, not from memory.
Mark every file minimal: true and say in the report which parts are minimal and what the full version would add.
Mark questions not collected from a real post as kind typical.
mustNotDo: Write a claim about treating or preventing an infection the label does not name.
Present 30 minimal questions as the project's full question map.
Fill an empty social-channel result with invented phrasings.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether the minimal set is honest about being minimal and faithful to the label's own TCM wording.

briefs.title: 波立维（硫酸氢氯吡格雷片）：原研与仿制药的身份
briefs.why: Clopidogrel has many generic holders in China, and patients ask whether 波立维 and 国产氯吡格雷 are the same. A claim library assembled from whichever label came up first mixes holders, strengths and label versions, and nothing on the page shows it.

competitors: 国产硫酸氢氯吡格雷片

mustDo: Map the product family (strengths, packs, approval records) and pick one focus SKU by rule, recording the choice as an assumption.
Take every claim from this holder's current label, and mark any generic's label as not the brand's.
Put bleeding, surgery or dental work while taking it, stopping without advice, and interacting medicines in P4 and on care nodes.
List competitors by the same indication with the reason each is one.
mustNotDo: Quote a generic manufacturer's label as 波立维's.
Write that the brand and a generic are or are not equivalent beyond what a regulator's document says.
Tell a patient to stop or switch the medicine.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether every claim names the right holder's label, and whether the interaction and bleeding questions are measured rather than answered.
